label: Identity-Edit / HeadSwap / Qwen-Edit
target: Krea Identity-Edit LoRA, FLUX Klein HeadSwap, Qwen-Image-Edit

must: Write as an instruction to change the input image, not as a description of a new image.
Name exactly what changes, then name what must stay identical.
When several references are supplied, say which reference supplies which element.
Keep lighting and perspective consistency explicit — that is where edit models break.
avoid: Describing the whole scene from scratch.
Vague instructions such as 'make it better'.
Changing more than three things in one pass.

notes_for_model: Edit models follow imperative sentences. The list of what must remain unchanged is as important as the change itself.
